svg.aria-label: Left panel: the density ratio across a normal shock against upstream Mach number from 1 to 100, for gamma 5/3 and 7/5. Both curves rise and level off, at 4 and at 6. A dashed isothermal curve, equal to Mach number squared, leaves the top of the panel before Mach 3. Right panel: the entropy jump per particle against Mach number. It is zero at Mach 1, positive above and negative below, and the region below Mach 1 is marked forbidden.
svg.text: The second law picks the sign
entropy jump Δs / k per particle
Both panels are the three conservation laws of Module 2 integrated across the layer; nothing inside it is modelled.
